citations.quote: 政府缺錢只要加大派息力度就可以了，大股東持股比例不低。
市場擔心的是$中国神华(01088)$ 將來會不會在上市公司層面直接上馬新能源項目。現在一直都是上市公司超高派息，然後再由母公司大額投資上馬新能源項目。
神華的小股東們更喜歡派息

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: A state controlling shareholder lets a cash-needy government raise the payout ratio instead of levying a windfall tax — the dominant stake captures the dividend. For high-payout SOE coal/power H-shares, check whether new-energy capex sits at the parent (payout-supportive) or the listed co (dilutive); minorities prefer dividends, and a payout-raising A-share relisting is the realistic catalyst.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: SOE windfall-tax fears vs the payout-ratio lever: dividends at the listed co, capex at the parent
